mapper.update: /* insertMasterMdCtBuyerChargeEntryList */ INSERT INTO MIS_BUYER_MNG ( SEQ, YEAR, BUYER, KEP_DEPT, KEP_USER_ID, ITEM_GROUP, ADD_DATE, ADD_TIME, CHANGE_DATE, CHANGE_TIME, POSITION_GROUP, START_SCOPE, END_SCOPE, PRIORITY, MAIN_CLERK, STATUS ) VALUES ( NVL((SELECT MAX(SEQ)+1 FROM MIS_BUYER_MNG WHERE YEAR=#{YEAR} AND BUYER=#{COM_CODE} AND KEP_DEPT=#{KEP_DEPT} AND ITEM_GROUP='M'),1), #{YEAR}, #{COM_CODE}, #{KEP_DEPT}, #{KEP_USER_ID}, 'M', TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS'), #{POSITION_GROUP}, 0, 10000000000, DECODE(#{PRIORITY}, '1', 'Y', ''), DECODE(#{MAIN_CLERK}, '1', 'Y', ''), 'C' )
